Faq.title: Questions before you book
Faq.subtitle: Straightforward answers about service, payment and care standards.

items.question: What if something gets damaged or missing?
items.answer: We fully vet our local specialists and carry comprehensive insurance coverage.

items.question: Do I need to provide cleaning supplies?
items.answer: No, our professionals bring high-quality eco-friendly products and standard equipment.

items.question: How do I pay for the service?
items.answer: Pay securely after the job is completed and inspected — via Cash, Card, or Revolut.

items.question: Can I book a recurring plan?
items.answer: Yes, we offer regular subscription plans that save you up to 20% on home care.

BookingWizard.quoteBannerBody: Describe the issue and add optional photos. Final price after we review.
BookingWizard.chooseRoomsHint: Select how many rooms need cleaning to see hours, cleaners and price.
BookingWizard.cleaningV1PresetsHint: Choose a typical layout. You can add extra rooms below.
BookingWizard.cleaningV1ExtraRoomsHint: Extras start at zero and add to the rooms already included above.
BookingWizard.cleaningV1ExtraRoomsCapped: Extra rooms were reduced to fit this layout’s limit: {rooms}.
BookingWizard.cleaningV1AddonsSectionHint: Optional extras with fixed person-minutes — not scaled by cleaning type.

cleaningV1AddonHints.windows: One unit = one standard window (both sashes): glass inside and the safely reachable outside, plus frame and sill. Panoramic, unusual or hard-to-reach windows are priced on site.

BookingWizard.cleaningV1IncompleteHint: Choose a cleaning type and a typical home to see the estimate.
BookingWizard.cleaningV1InvalidHint: Check the room counts and cleaning type — the estimate could not be calculated.
BookingWizard.cleaningV1MinimumPriceNote: A minimum booking of {min} applies to this estimate.
BookingWizard.cleaningV1EstimateNote: Recommended team and visit length are estimates. The final crew is confirmed by HAVENLY. Price is based on total cleaning hours at the rate shown — not on how many cleaners arrive.
BookingWizard.cleaningV1CleanersNote: Final cleaner count is confirmed by HAVENLY after reviewing your booking.
BookingWizard.cleaningV1ExtrasConfirmNote: Extra tasks and timing are agreed with you on site before the work is done.
BookingWizard.estimateRevisedBody: Our estimate was updated. Please review the new total of {total} before sending again. Your previous booking request is still protected.
BookingWizard.cleaningV1QuoteBody: This request needs a HAVENLY review. We will confirm the price after assessing it — no fixed price is shown here.
BookingWizard.successCleaningV1QuoteNote: This request needs a HAVENLY review — no fixed price was confirmed at booking.
BookingWizard.cleaningV1PreviewHint: Cleaning v1 submission stays disabled while you preview the new options.
BookingWizard.massageV1PreviewHint: Massage & Wellness booking is in preview. Submission stays disabled until enabled.
BookingWizard.problemPlaceholder: What needs fixing? Where is it? Any urgency?
BookingWizard.photosHint: JPG, JPEG, PNG or WEBP. Thumbnails appear right after you choose files. “Uploaded” only after the server confirms.
BookingWizard.timeHint: Selected: {time}. Preferred start — we confirm availability separately.
BookingWizard.photosFailedReview: {count, plural, one {# photo failed — go back and retry before submitting.} other {# photos failed — go back and retry before submitting.}}
BookingWizard.sendWithoutPhotos: Send this quote request without photos
BookingWizard.securityHint: Cloudflare check before sending your request. This is not a photo upload status.
BookingWizard.successBody: Your booking reference is <ref>{orderRef}</ref>. We will confirm the visit shortly.
BookingWizard.successRepairNote: Home repair is quoted after assessment — no price was charged at booking.
BookingWizard.unresolvedAttemptBody: A previous send may still be processing. Retry with the same details, or start a new booking.

cleaning.title: Cleaning
cleaning.subtitle: Explore each room — tap a marker to see exactly what we clean.

hob.title: Hob & stove
hob.text: We degrease the hob, burners and nearby splash zones until they look brand new.

counters.title: Worktops
counters.text: Counters are wiped, crumbs removed, and every surface left fresh and clear.

fronts.title: Cabinet fronts
fronts.text: Fronts and handles are cleaned of fingerprints, marks and light grease.

sink.title: Sink & faucet
sink.text: The sink and faucet are cleaned and polished, with available dishes washed and left tidy.

toilet.title: Toilet
toilet.text: The bowl and seat are disinfected carefully for a hygienic finish.

taps.title: Taps & chrome
taps.text: Mixers and chrome details are washed and polished to a soft shine.

glass.title: Shower glass
glass.text: Glass panels are cleaned streak-free so the shower feels bright again.

floor.title: Floor
floor.text: The bathroom floor is vacuumed and mopped with care.

under-bed.title: Under the bed
under-bed.text: Accessible areas under the bed are vacuumed and left dust-free.

bedding.title: Bedding
bedding.text: Bed linen is straightened or remade so the room feels calm and finished.

dusting.title: Dusting
dusting.text: Light objects are lifted so shelves and surfaces are dusted properly.

mirrors.title: Mirrors & glass
mirrors.text: Mirrors and glass are cleaned streak-free for a bright look.

surfaces.title: Surfaces
surfaces.text: Tables, shelves and décor surfaces are dusted and wiped gently.

floors.title: Floors
floors.text: Floors are vacuumed and washed, including easy-to-reach corners.

glass.title: Glass & frames
glass.text: Glass details and frames are cleaned for a clear, polished finish.

repair.title: Home Repairs
repair.subtitle: Tap the markers to see the careful, everyday fixes we handle at home.

assemble.title: Furniture assembly
assemble.text: Neat flat-pack assembly for shelves, desks and wardrobes.

shelves.title: Shelves & mounting
shelves.text: Shelves are mounted level and secured cleanly on the wall.

taps.title: Taps & mixers
taps.text: We replace or adjust taps and mixers for smooth everyday use.

minor-leak.title: Minor plumbing
minor-leak.text: Seals, connections and simple leak checks — tidy and careful.

sockets.title: Sockets & switches
sockets.text: Sockets and switches replaced for safer, cleaner daily use.

fixtures.title: Light fixtures
fixtures.text: Standard light fixtures hung and connected neatly.

hinges.title: Hinges & alignment
hinges.text: Doors are adjusted so they close smoothly and quietly again.

handles.title: Handles & locks
handles.text: Handle and lock fixes for everyday doors around the home.

MassageWellness.heroTagline: Premium in-home care at accessible prices — massage and wellness technology, delivered to you.
MassageWellness.discoverMassagesIntro: Four focused experiences. Transparent rates. Home visit included within our service area.
MassageWellness.discoverTechIntro: Optional NovuMedical equipment to enhance your massage. Availability for booking is confirmed separately.
MassageWellness.includedDevices: Includes FootSystem, EyeSystem, Moxi and TopRelax

relaxing-60.title: Relaxing Massage
relaxing-60.short: A calm full-body reset at home.
relaxing-60.description: Unhurried pace in the privacy of your villa or apartment. Home visit included.

sports-60.title: Sports Massage
sports-60.description: Deeper, purposeful techniques after training or a demanding day — at your place.

targeted-30.title: Targeted Massage
targeted-30.short: A shorter session on one priority area.
targeted-30.description: Thirty focused minutes where you need them most.

targeted-60.title: Targeted Massage
targeted-60.short: Extended focus on your priority area.
targeted-60.description: Sixty minutes of targeted care in the comfort of home.

premium-wellness-120.title: Premium Wellness
premium-wellness-120.short: Two serene hours — massage and all four wellness devices, included.
premium-wellness-120.description: A fixed complex with massage and wellness technology. Home visit included. Device sequence is confirmed after safety review.

foot-system.name: FootSystem
foot-system.purpose: Designed for comfortable foot and lower-leg care as an add-on to your massage.
foot-system.howItWorks: Used as a complementary wellness procedure. Exact protocol is confirmed with you before the visit.
foot-system.limitations: Not a medical treatment. Contraindications and suitability are reviewed before booking is enabled.
foot-system.imageAlt: FootSystem in a bright home interior during a wellness session
foot-system.deviceImageAlt: FootSystem device on a light background

eye-system.name: EyeSystem
eye-system.purpose: A gentle wellness add-on focused on the eye area.
eye-system.howItWorks: Scheduled around your massage session. Steps are explained before use.
eye-system.limitations: Not a medical treatment. Booking stays closed until instructions and contraindications are verified.
eye-system.imageAlt: EyeSystem worn during a calm home wellness moment
eye-system.deviceImageAlt: EyeSystem device on a white background

moxi.name: Moxi
moxi.purpose: A short wellness add-on planned for use during the massage.
moxi.howItWorks: Applied as part of the session timing without extending the visit clock.
moxi.limitations: Preliminary scheduling rule only — not a confirmed medical protocol. Safety review required before booking.
moxi.imageAlt: Moxi used during a home wellness session

top-relax.name: TopRelax
top-relax.purpose: A brief wellness add-on planned alongside manual massage.
top-relax.howItWorks: Fits within the massage window; no extra booking minutes in the current catalog.
top-relax.limitations: Not a medical treatment. Real booking remains gated until compatibility and contraindications are cleared.
top-relax.imageAlt: TopRelax used in a bright bedroom wellness setting

MassageCatalog.title: Massage
MassageCatalog.tagline: Professional massage, brought to the comfort of your home.
MassageCatalog.intro: Every session is delivered to your villa or apartment in the Algarve — choose the focus that suits your day.
MassageCatalog.durationHint: Choose your length in the booking form — same transparent rates as always.

relaxing.title: Relaxing Massage
relaxing.short: A quiet full-body reset in the comfort of your own villa or apartment.
relaxing.description: A calm, unhurried session delivered where you live — no travel, no waiting room. Soft pacing and a private atmosphere so you can settle into rest at home in the Algarve.
relaxing.imageAlt: In-home relaxing massage in a bright residential interior

back-neck.title: Back & Neck Massage
back-neck.short: Focused back and neck care without leaving your living space.
back-neck.description: Shoulders, neck and back — treated at home after desk work, driving or a long day. You stay in your own space; we bring the session to you.
back-neck.imageAlt: Back massage prepared in a warm home setting

face-head.title: Face & Head Massage
face-head.short: Gentle face and scalp work in the quiet of your own rooms.
face-head.description: Light touch for the face, temples, jaw and scalp — in a familiar, private space. Ideal when you want mental quiet without stepping into a salon.
face-head.imageAlt: Gentle face and head massage in a home wellness setting

legs-feet.title: Legs & Feet Massage
legs-feet.short: Legs and feet cared for at home after walks, travel or a warm day.
legs-feet.description: From calves to soles — delivered in your villa or apartment so tired legs can recover where you already are. Steady rhythm, grounded comfort, no clinic feel.
legs-feet.imageAlt: Legs and feet massage on a soft towel at home
